order: Draft the round's re-review instructions for the latest applied fix. Pin the exact 2-commit range it covers by full commit identifiers, enumerated in full, so the reviewer works against a fixed diff that cannot drift. State plainly that the point of this round is to get an explicit ruling on the one residual strand still open, and that strand alone, but never to reopen anything already resolved in a prior round. Make clear that a clean verdict at this round is exactly what clears the two blocked tracks out of their needs-revision state, not a partial or provisional clearance. The reviewer should understand the stakes of the ruling about to be made, and not just the mechanics of what to check. Keep the order and its companion writeup distinct from every prior round's file, which stays untouched throughout this entire pass.
claims: Wrote the round's re-review instructions and its companion writeup as two new files. The order pins the exact 2-commit range under review by full commit identifiers rather than a branch tip, so the diff being reviewed cannot drift at all. It states the one residual strand awaiting a ruling and what a clean verdict would clear, and nothing more than that. No prior file was touched by this pass, and both new files are brand new additions.
